question: In a room containing 45 students there were twice as many girls as boys. How many of each, were there?
If five is subtracted from three times a certain number, the result is 10. What is the number?
A number plus itself, plus twice itself, plus 4 times itself, is equal to 104. What is the number?
The third angle of a triangle is the same size as the first. The second angle is 4 times the third. Find the measure of the angles.
The perimeter of a college basketball court is 96 meters and the length is 14 meters more than the width. What are the dimensions?
A mountain cabin on 1 acre of land costs $30,000. If the land cost 4 times as much as the cabin, what was the cost of each?
Of 240 stamps that Harry and his sister collected, Harry collected 3 times as many as his sisters. How many did each collect?
If Mr. Brown and his son together had $220, and Mr. Brown had 10 times as much as his son, how much money had each?
A man bought a cow and a calf for $990, paying 8 times as much for the cow as for the calf. What was the cost of each?
A lab technician cuts a 12 inch piece of tubing into two pieces in such a way that one piece is 2 times longer than the other. How long are the pieces?
A 6 ft board is cut into two pieces, one twice as long as the other. How long are the pieces?
The cost of a private pilot course is $1,275. The flight portion costs $625 more than the ground school portion. What is the cost of each?
A square kitchen has an area of 100 square feet. What is the kitchen's perimeter?
The length of a rectangular field is 75 meters. Its width is 15 meters. Sofie ran around the track 3 times. How far did she run?
The area of square photo is 25 square inches. Angie decided to enlarge the photo by doubling the sides. What will the new area be?

Bridget needs to make rectangular cards measuring 2 inches by 3 inches. She will cut them from a square sheet of poster board measuring 1 foot on each side. What is the greatest number of cards that Bridget can make?
Doug built a tent in the shape of a regular pentagon. Its perimeter is 60 feet. What is the length of each side of the tent?
Emma's room measures 12 feet by 20 feet. She purchased 40 tiles for a section of the floor. Each tile is 1 square foot. What fractional part of the room will have tile?
Math Magazine charges $8 per square inch for advertising. Jason decides to order a half page ad. Each page of the magazine measures 9 inches by 12 inches. How much will Jason have to pay?
The distance around a rectangular garden is 36 feet. One side measures 10 feet. What is the area of the garden?
Mrs. Garvey's bathroom measures 6 feet by 10 feet. She wants to cover the floor with square tiles. The sides of the tiles are 6 inches. How many tiles will Mrs. Garvey need?
Mr. Johnson used 80 meters of fencing to enclose a rectangular garden. The length of the garden is 25 meters. How wide is the garden?
A rectangle has an area of 360 square centimeters. It is 20 centimeters long. What is its perimeter?
A square garden has a perimeter of 48 meters. A pond inside the garden has an area of 20 square meters. What is the area of the garden that is not taken up by the pond?
A rectangular living room measures 12 feet by 10 feet. A carpet placed on the floor leaves a border 2 feet wide all around it. What is the area of the border?
